question: For a unit-S3 zonal scalar packet psi in q_ab(epsilon)=a^2 exp(2 epsilon psi) gamma_ab, what exact epsilon^1, epsilon^2 and epsilon^3 spatial-curvature-density coefficients and hard-cutoff tails occur in the declared zonal subspace?

upstream_results.role: pins q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab, unit-S3 volume and curvature, and the explicit boundary that its linear gauge check was not a full constraint derivation
pins normalized zonal Q_n product and hard-projection convention; no full scalar or SVT Gaunt system is imported
pins unit-S3 Laplacian and low-mode conventions while explicitly withholding a complete basis, Gaunt data and HDA

declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3: R[gamma]=6, Ric_ab[gamma]=2 gamma_ab, Delta=D^aD_a, and integral_S3 1=2*pi^2
declared_conventions.zonal_basis: Q_n(chi)=U_n(cos chi)/sqrt(2*pi^2), Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n, and Q_a Q_b=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) sum_{j=0}^{min(a,b)} Q_{a+b-2j}
declared_conventions.metric_ansatz: q_ab(epsilon)=a^2 exp(2 epsilon psi) gamma_ab with a spatial constant treated as an external positive factor
declared_conventions.curvature_density: sqrt(q) R[q]/(a sqrt(gamma))=exp(epsilon psi)[6-4 epsilon Delta psi-2 epsilon^2 |D psi|^2]
declared_conventions.density_coefficients: d1=6psi-4Delta psi; d2=3psi^2-4psi Delta psi-2|Dpsi|^2; d3=psi^3-2psi^2 Delta psi-2psi|Dpsi|^2
declared_conventions.integrated_coefficients: I1=6 integral psi; I2=3 integral psi^2+2 integral |Dpsi|^2; I3=integral psi^3+2 integral psi|Dpsi|^2
declared_conventions.hard_cutoff: P_N retains zonal Q_0 through Q_N after the declared local density coefficient is formed; a density tail is a truncation diagnostic, not an ADM algebra residual

coefficient_packets.purpose: smallest zero-mean one-mode conformal packet whose quadratic and cubic curvature-density coefficients emit modes beyond N=2
smallest mixed zero-mean packet exposing derivative and product cross-terms

form the local d1, d2 and d3 curvature-density coefficient vectors exactly from zonal products and Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n
verify the Taylor reconstruction of exp(epsilon psi)[6-4 epsilon Delta psi-2 epsilon^2 |Dpsi|^2 through order epsilon^3 and the integrated I1/I2/I3 formulas
record P_N density coefficients, discarded tails and exact tail norms separately at quadratic and cubic order
leave all lapse, shift, momenta, matter perturbations, nonzonal modes, ADM constraints, brackets, BFV and physical outputs null
